run_make_cmakelists: run make_cmakelists.py with an output path argument to generate a CMakeLists.txt from BUILD and WORKSPACE files
convert_build_to_cmake: convert Bazel BUILD and WORKSPACE files into a CMakeLists.txt file using the converter script
review_cc_library: review the cc_library function to understand how it generates add_library CMake commands for source and header-only libraries
review_strip_colons: review the StripColons function that removes leading colons from Bazel dependency paths for CMake compatibility
review_is_source_file: review the IsSourceFile function that checks if a filename ends with .c or .cc extensions
